name: Identification Assignment 4
definition: Provides the details of the identification assignment.

MessageIdentification.name: Message Identification
MessageIdentification.definition: Point to point reference, as assigned by the assigner, and sent to the next party in the chain to unambiguously identify the message.||Usage: The assigner has to make sure that MessageIdentification is unique per assignee for a pre-agreed period.

CreationDateTime.name: Creation Date Time
CreationDateTime.definition: Date and time at which the identification assignment was created.

Creator.name: Creator
Creator.definition: Party that created the identification assignment.

FirstAgent.name: First Agent
FirstAgent.definition: Identifies the first agent in the identification chain, following the payment initiating party.

Assigner.name: Assigner
Assigner.definition: Party that assigns the identification assignment to another party. This is also the sender of the message.

Assignee.name: Assignee
Assignee.definition: Party that the identification assignment is assigned to. This is also the receiver of the message.
